domain_specific_rationale: From the Contracts perspective, defining a deterministic idempotency key derivation formula SHA256(shot_version_id + prompt_version_id + provider_id + attempt_index + parameters_hash) and enforcing idempotency_key (minLength: 16) as a mandatory property in domain-entities.schema.json#//GenerationJob and provider-request.schema.json eliminates race conditions and duplicate submissions at the contract interface boundary. Standardizing this requirement across API requests and database entities guarantees idempotency invariants (INV-008) without relying on vendor-specific deduplication logic.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-01 (Canonical Core State), CAP-03 (Provider Abstraction), and CAP-12 (Autonomous Error Recovery).
residual_risk: Inconsistent hashing of parameters_hash due to non-canonical JSON key ordering could cause unintended idempotency mismatches. Mitigated by mandating RFC 8785 canonical JSON sorting before SHA256 computation.
